infos.prompt: What work do you have for me?
lines: A merchant drowned in the deep water a short walk south-east of the trapdoor you came down. His lockbox of pledges lies locked on the floor, where he went down. A pledge is a thing a client left with him against a loan.
Three of his clients are on the south bank of the deep water, and each says one thing in the box is theirs. I want the box emptied before they find one. Dive down, open it and take what is inside.
What becomes of what you take is yours to say. I will not tell you whom to give it to.

The Chapter takes from those who can bear the loss, and these pledges are other people's. Whoever holds them can sell them back, or can sell silence about them. Blackmail is no trade of ours, and I will not have a Lookout of mine in it.
